text:
FINANCIAL DATA PROTECTION OFFICE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Responding to customer data access requests
Notice number: RCN-2026-002
Issued by: Financial Data Protection Office
Published: 2026-08-11
Effective date: 2026-12-01
1. Who this applies to
Any firm that holds personal data about retail customers.
2. Background
The Office has reviewed how financial firms handle requests from customers who want a copy of the data held about them. Response times varied widely and records of requests were often incomplete.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must respond to a customer data access request within 30 calendar days of receiving it, providing a copy of the personal data held.
3.2 A firm must keep a log of every data access request, including the date received, the date answered and the outcome.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2026-12-01.

obligations.policyTitle: Privacy and Data Subject Rights Procedure
obligations.controlDesc: Weekly report of data access requests open for more than 20 days, with escalation before the 30-day limit
obligations.reason: Policy POL-PRV-01 states "Requests are answered within 30 calendar days" which matches the obligation's 30 calendar day deadline exactly, and Control CTL-131 escalates requests open for more than 20 days "before the 30-day limit" which would detect potential breaches of this specific obligation.
